name: line-by-level
description: A line chart over named steps (effort levels, versions, weeks), one labelled line per series.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: names of the x steps, left to right

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: list of (name, values, colour), one value per level

parameters.name: y_ticks
parameters.description: values that get a gridline; default quarters of y_max

returns: VGroup with .grid, .xlabels, .lines (VGroup(line, dots, labels) per series), .legend; point(chart, i, v) gives a position
